summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market purchases under its ongoing share repurchase programme, equivalent to a US issuer buyback disclosure. Under the tranche initiated 6 May 2026, the Danish pharmaceutical company may repurchase up to DKK 11.2bn of B shares through 1 February 2027, part of a broader DKK 15bn 12-month programme begun 4 February 2026. Since 4 February 2026 it has bought 37,849,179 B shares at an average DKK 278.97, roughly DKK 10.56bn, with treasury stock now 51,889,876 B shares, or 1.2% of capital. Watch execution pace, remaining authorisation, and any signal on capital allocation priorities.
